title: Want free access to Bloomberg Terminal–level market data? Your next two months are on us.
author: Fynca
selftext:
I’m one of Fynca’s founders. We’re giving **two months free to everyone who signs up during the upcoming trading week.**

https://i.redd.it/i5a9jnsqjtxh1.png

Fynca brings stock charts, financials, SEC filings, earnings transcripts and news into one visual workspace, with AI that works across the sources you connect.

Pick a company you own or are thinking about buying. Open its financials alongside its earnings call and start asking the questions that matter:

* Is revenue growth actually turning into cash?
* Do the numbers support what management is saying?
* What changed between reports that could challenge your thesis?

You can explore those questions with the documents, data and charts in front of you, and collaborate with others on the same canvas.

Try it on a stock you know well. We’d love to hear what you find useful, and where you think we need to do better.
